verdict.rationale: Docs confirm a create-contact endpoint and general API root/account export capabilities, implying CRUD-style contact management, but the pack never documents update or suppress/archive endpoints, custom merge-field properties, or rate limits/batch operations that would demonstrate production-scale reliability. missing for 10: explicit update-contact endpoint, explicit suppress/archive-contact endpoint, custom merge-field property docs, evidence of batch/production-scale throughput.
